senses.en: full of fog; misty
confused or unclear

ex.en: On foggy mornings, drivers must slow down on the highway.
ex.zh: 起霧的早晨，駕駛在高速公路上必須減速。

mn: 常見片語 I haven't the foggiest idea（我完全不知道）。

senses.en: a minor weakness or odd habit in someone's character

ex.en: His only foible is that he always arrives five minutes late.
ex.zh: 他唯一的小毛病就是總會遲到五分鐘。

senses.en: to force someone to accept something unwanted

ex.en: Don't try to foist your old furniture on your neighbors.
ex.zh: 別想把你的舊家具硬塞給鄰居。

mn: 常用 foist something on/upon someone。

senses.en: the leaves of a plant or tree, collectively

ex.en: Tourists travel to Kyoto each autumn to see the red foliage.
ex.zh: 每年秋天，遊客都會到京都欣賞紅葉。

senses.en: a large sheet folded once to make two leaves of a book; a book of such size
a page or leaf number

ex.en: The library owns a rare folio of Shakespeare's plays.
ex.zh: 這間圖書館收藏一本罕見的莎士比亞劇作對開本。

senses.en: the traditional beliefs, stories, and customs of a community

ex.en: According to local folklore, a dragon once lived in the lake.
ex.zh: 根據當地的民間傳說，湖裡曾經住著一條龍。

root.note: 民間流傳的知識 → 民俗

senses.en: to touch or stroke gently and lovingly

ex.en: The little girl liked to fondle the kitten's soft ears.
ex.zh: 小女孩喜歡撫摸小貓柔軟的耳朵。

senses.en: foolish behavior or actions

ex.en: The teacher had no patience for foolery during the exam.
ex.zh: 考試期間老師對胡鬧毫無耐心。

senses.en: a note printed at the bottom of a page (usually spelled footnote)
a minor or less important event

ex.en: The author added a foot-note to explain the old term.
ex.zh: 作者加了一個註腳來解釋那個舊詞。

root.note: 寫在頁面底部的註記 → 註腳

senses.en: excessive concern with clothes and appearance
senses.zh: （男子）過度講究打扮；紈褲習氣

ex.en: His silk gloves and perfumed hair were pure foppery.
ex.zh: 他的絲質手套和噴了香水的頭髮純粹是紈褲子弟的做作。

senses.en: (of a man) too concerned with clothes and appearance
senses.zh: （男子）過分講究衣著的；花花公子的

ex.en: The foppish young lord changed his coat three times a day.
ex.zh: 那位愛打扮的年輕貴族一天要換三次外套。

senses.en: patient self-control; tolerance

ex.en: The nurse showed great forbearance with the difficult patient.
ex.zh: 護理師對那位難搞的病人展現了極大的耐心。

senses.en: (archaic, Scottish) besides; in addition
(archaic, Scottish) besides; except

ex.en: The old ballad says the shepherd had a dog, and forby a flock of sheep.
ex.zh: 那首古老的民謠說，牧羊人有一條狗，此外還有一群羊。

senses.en: done using physical force
forceful and convincing

ex.en: Police found no signs of forcible entry into the house.
ex.zh: 警方在屋子裡沒發現強行闖入的跡象。

senses.en: to act as a warning of something bad; to predict

ex.en: The dark clouds seemed to forebode a terrible storm.
ex.zh: 烏雲似乎預示著一場可怕的暴風雨。

mn: 名詞 foreboding（不祥的預感）更常用。

senses.en: a prediction of future events, especially weather
to predict

ex.en: The weather forecast says it will rain all weekend.
ex.zh: 天氣預報說整個週末都會下雨。

root.note: 預先把眼光投向未來 → 預測

senses.en: the front part of a ship below the deck, where sailors live

ex.en: The sailors slept in the cramped forecastle at the bow.
ex.zh: 水手們睡在船頭擁擠的水手艙裡。

root.note: 古代戰船前方像城堡的高台 → 前甲板

mn: 航海用語唸作 [ˋfoksḷ]，常縮寫為 fo'c'sle。

senses.en: to take possession of a property because the owner failed to pay the mortgage
senses.zh: （因未繳房貸）取消贖回權；查封

senses.en: to rule out or prevent

ex.en: The bank may foreclose on the house if the payments stop.
ex.zh: 如果停止繳款，銀行可能會把房子收回拍賣。

root.note: 把人關在外面 → 取消贖回權

senses.en: an open area in front of a large building or gas station

ex.en: Visitors gathered in the forecourt of the palace to watch the guards.
ex.zh: 遊客聚集在宮殿前庭觀看衛兵。

senses.en: an ancestor, especially a male one

ex.en: Each forefather in our family tree was a farmer.
ex.zh: 我們族譜上的每一位祖先都是農夫。

senses.en: to go before; to precede (also used as a variant of forgo)
senses.zh: 在…之前；居先（亦作 forgo 的異體：放棄）

ex.en: Many people chose to forego dessert after the heavy meal.
ex.zh: 吃完豐盛的一餐後，很多人選擇不吃甜點。

mn: 常用形容詞 foregone conclusion（必然的結果）。

senses.en: the part of a scene nearest to the viewer
the most important position
to make something the most prominent

ex.en: In the foreground of the photo, a child is feeding ducks.
ex.zh: 照片的前景中，有個小孩在餵鴨子。

senses.en: the part of the face above the eyebrows

ex.en: She wiped the sweat from her forehead after the run.
ex.zh: 跑完步後，她擦掉額頭上的汗。

senses.en: of or from another country
strange or unfamiliar

ex.en: Learning a foreign language opens many doors.
ex.zh: 學習一門外語能開啟許多機會。

senses.en: a person from another country

ex.en: As a foreigner, he found the local customs fascinating.
ex.zh: 身為外國人，他覺得當地習俗非常有趣。

senses.en: to judge before hearing the facts; to prejudge

ex.en: We should not forejudge the new student before we get to know her.
ex.zh: 在認識新同學之前，我們不應該先入為主地評斷她。

senses.en: awareness of something before it happens

ex.en: The official denied having any foreknowledge of the attack.
ex.zh: 那位官員否認事先知道這次攻擊。

senses.en: a worker who supervises other workers
the person who speaks for a jury

ex.en: The foreman checked each worker's safety gear before the shift.
ex.zh: 工頭在上工前檢查每位工人的安全裝備。

root.note: 站在前面帶頭的人 → 工頭

senses.en: (of God or fate) to decide or determine in advance

ex.en: Some believe that fate can foreordain every event in our lives.
ex.zh: 有些人相信命運預先注定了我們生命中的每件事。

senses.en: the act of deciding something in advance, as by God or fate

ex.en: The sermon touched on the idea of foreordination and free will.
ex.zh: 那場講道談到了宿命與自由意志的概念。

senses.en: the narrow space in the bow of a ship

ex.en: Extra ropes and anchors were stored in the forepeak.
ex.zh: 多餘的繩索和錨都存放在首尖艙裡。

senses.en: to come before; to be a sign of what is coming

ex.en: Small tremors often forerun a major earthquake.
ex.zh: 小規模的震動常常是大地震的前兆。

root.note: 跑在前面 → 先行、預示

senses.en: the main sail on the foremast of a ship

ex.en: The crew raised the foresail as the wind picked up.
ex.zh: 風勢漸強，船員們升起了前帆。

senses.en: to know or expect that something will happen

ex.en: No one could foresee how quickly the virus would spread.
ex.zh: 沒有人能預見病毒會傳播得這麼快。

senses.en: the part of a shore between high and low tide marks

ex.en: At low tide, children search the foreshore for crabs.
ex.zh: 退潮時，孩子們在潮間帶找螃蟹。

senses.en: the ability to predict and prepare for future needs

ex.en: Thanks to her foresight, we had enough water when the pipes burst.
ex.zh: 多虧她有先見之明，水管爆裂時我們才有足夠的水。

root.note: 預先看到的能力 → 遠見

senses.en: to predict the future

ex.en: Nobody can foretell exactly what the stock market will do.
ex.zh: 沒有人能準確預言股市的走勢。

senses.en: careful thought and planning for the future

ex.en: With a little forethought, you can avoid most travel problems.
ex.zh: 只要事先稍加考慮，就能避免大部分的旅遊問題。

senses.en: to lose or give up something as a penalty
something lost as a penalty

ex.en: If you cancel late, you will forfeit your deposit.
ex.zh: 如果太晚取消，你的訂金就會被沒收。

senses.en: (archaic) to prevent or forbid, as in "heaven forfend"

ex.en: "Heaven forfend that we should be late!" she joked.
ex.zh: 「老天保佑我們別遲到！」她開玩笑說。

senses.en: the crime of making a fake copy of something
a forged document or artwork

ex.en: Experts proved the famous painting was a forgery.
ex.zh: 專家證實那幅名畫是贗品。

parts.m: shape metal, fake 鍛造、偽造

senses.en: to choose to go without something you want

ex.en: She decided to forgo her vacation to finish the project.
ex.zh: 為了完成專案，她決定放棄休假。

mn: forgo（放棄）與 forego（居先）常被混用。

senses.en: the process of forming something
a particular arrangement or shape

ex.en: The geese flew south in a V formation.
ex.zh: 雁群排成 V 字隊形向南飛。

senses.en: inspiring fear or respect through being powerful or capable
senses.zh: 令人敬畏的；強大的；難對付的

ex.en: The defending champion is a formidable opponent.
ex.zh: 衛冕冠軍是個難纏的對手。

root.note: 令人害怕的 → 可畏的

senses.en: a rule or fact written with mathematical symbols
a method or recipe for achieving something
powdered milk for babies

ex.en: Use this formula to find the area of a circle.
ex.zh: 用這個公式來求圓的面積。

root.note: 小小的固定形式 → 公式

senses.en: to promise to give up something
to lie under oath

ex.en: After the accident, he vowed to forswear drinking forever.
ex.zh: 那次車禍後，他發誓永遠戒酒。

senses.en: a thing at which someone excels
[ˋfɔrtɪ] (music) loudly

ex.en: Cooking is not my forte, but I make a good omelet.
ex.zh: 做菜不是我的專長，但我煎的歐姆蛋還不錯。

senses.en: forward or onward in time or place
out into view

ex.en: The dog ran back and forth along the fence.
ex.zh: 那隻狗沿著籬笆來回奔跑。

mn: 常見片語 back and forth（來回）、and so forth（等等）。

senses.en: direct and honest in speech or manner

ex.en: She gave a forthright answer about her mistakes.
ex.zh: 她坦白地說明了自己的錯誤。

senses.en: to strengthen a place against attack
to strengthen physically or mentally; to add nutrients to food

ex.en: Many companies fortify their cereal with vitamins and iron.
ex.zh: 許多公司在穀片中添加維生素和鐵來強化營養。

senses.en: courage in facing pain or difficulty

ex.en: She faced her long illness with remarkable fortitude.
ex.zh: 她以非凡的堅忍面對長期的病痛。

root.note: 內心強大的狀態 → 堅忍

senses.en: a group of four people, especially playing a game together

ex.en: We need one more player to make a foursome for golf.
ex.zh: 我們還需要一個人才能湊成四人一組打高爾夫。

senses.en: a crack or break, especially in a bone
to break or crack; to split a group

ex.en: The X-ray showed a small fracture in his wrist.
ex.zh: X 光顯示他的手腕有輕微骨折。

senses.en: easily broken or damaged
(of a situation or person) weak or delicate

ex.en: Please handle the box carefully because the glasses are fragile.
ex.zh: 請小心搬這個箱子，因為裡面的玻璃杯很易碎。

senses.en: physical weakness
a moral weakness or fault

ex.en: Jealousy is a common human frailty.
ex.zh: 嫉妒是人類常見的弱點。

parts.m: weak 虛弱（源自 frag 破裂）

senses.en: a fragrant resin burned as incense

ex.en: In the story, the wise men brought gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
ex.zh: 故事中，東方三博士帶來了黃金、乳香和沒藥。

senses.en: wild or distraught with fear, worry, or hurry
senses.zh: 發狂似的；慌亂的；手忙腳亂的

ex.en: The frantic mother searched the mall for her lost child.
ex.zh: 那位心急如焚的母親在商場裡尋找走失的孩子。

senses.en: of or like brothers; friendly
(of twins) developed from two separate eggs

ex.en: They are fraternal twins, so they do not look exactly alike.
ex.zh: 他們是異卵雙胞胎，所以長得不完全一樣。

senses.en: the quality of being deceitful or dishonest

ex.en: The auditors uncovered clear fraudulence in the company's accounts.
ex.zh: 審計人員揭發了公司帳目中明顯的欺詐行為。

senses.en: obtained or done by deception, especially illegally

ex.en: The bank blocked several fraudulent charges on my credit card.
ex.zh: 銀行攔下了我信用卡上幾筆盜刷的費用。

root.note: 充滿欺騙的 → 欺詐的

senses.en: a noisy fight, quarrel, or competition
(of fabric or rope) to wear at the edges and unravel
(of nerves or temper) to show strain

ex.en: Two more candidates entered the fray just before the deadline.
ex.zh: 截止前又有兩位候選人加入戰局。

senses.en: relating to international trade without tariffs or restrictions

ex.en: The two nations signed a free-trade agreement last year.
ex.zh: 兩國去年簽訂了自由貿易協定。

senses.en: a member of an international secret fraternal society (the Freemasons)

ex.en: His great-grandfather was a freemason in the 1890s.
ex.zh: 他的曾祖父在十九世紀九〇年代是共濟會會員。

root.note: 原指自由行動的石匠公會 → 共濟會會員

senses.en: a person who forms opinions by reason rather than authority, especially about religion
senses.zh: 自由思想家（尤指不受宗教教條約束者）

ex.en: As a freethinker, she questioned every tradition she was taught.
ex.zh: 身為自由思想者，她質疑自己所學的每一項傳統。

senses.en: the rate at which something happens
(physics) the number of waves per second

ex.en: The frequency of heavy storms has increased in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年來強烈暴風雨的發生頻率增加了。

senses.en: a painting done on wet plaster on a wall or ceiling

ex.en: Michelangelo painted the famous fresco on the chapel ceiling.
ex.zh: 米開朗基羅在禮拜堂天花板上畫了那幅著名的濕壁畫。

root.note: 畫在新鮮（濕）灰泥上 → 濕壁畫

senses.en: the quality of being new, fresh, or original

ex.en: Store the bread in a sealed bag to keep its freshness.
ex.zh: 把麵包放進密封袋裡以保持新鮮。

senses.en: anxious, irritable, or restless

ex.en: The fretful baby cried until his mother picked him up.
ex.zh: 那個煩躁的嬰兒一直哭，直到媽媽把他抱起來。

root.note: 充滿煩惱的 → 焦躁的

senses.en: very unpleasant, serious, or shocking
(informal) extremely bad; very great

ex.en: The traffic this morning was frightful.
ex.zh: 今天早上的交通糟透了。

root.note: 充滿驚嚇的 → 可怕的

senses.en: very cold
stiff or formal in manner; lacking warmth

ex.en: The explorers survived the frigid Antarctic winter.
ex.zh: 探險家們熬過了南極的酷寒冬天。

mn: frig 就是 fridge（冰箱）的冷。

senses.en: the room with a cold pool in an ancient Roman bath

ex.en: After the hot bath, Romans plunged into the frigidarium.
ex.zh: 泡完熱水澡後，羅馬人會跳進冷水浴室。

root.note: 冷的地方 → 冷水浴室

senses.en: lack of seriousness; lighthearted fun

ex.en: There was no room for frivolity during the serious meeting.
ex.zh: 在嚴肅的會議中容不得嬉鬧。

senses.en: not serious; lacking purpose or value
(of a person) silly and not serious

ex.en: The judge dismissed the case as a frivolous lawsuit.
ex.zh: 法官以濫訴為由駁回了這起案件。

senses.en: (of hair) to form into tight, wiry curls
a mass of tightly curled hair

ex.en: Humid weather makes my hair frizz.
ex.zh: 潮濕的天氣會讓我的頭髮變得毛躁。

senses.en: to fry with a sizzling noise until crisp
to form hair into tight curls

ex.en: Let the bacon frizzle in the pan until it turns golden.
ex.zh: 讓培根在鍋裡滋滋作響，煎到金黃。

senses.en: lively and playful

ex.en: The frolicsome lambs chased each other across the meadow.
ex.zh: 活潑的小羊在草地上互相追逐。

senses.en: a border between two countries
the limit of knowledge or activity in a field

ex.en: Space remains the final frontier for human exploration.
ex.zh: 太空仍是人類探索的最後疆域。

root.note: 最前面的地方 → 邊境、前沿

senses.en: scruffy and neglected in appearance; musty
senses.zh: 邋遢的；不整潔的；有霉味的

ex.en: The old inn had frowzy curtains and a musty smell.
ex.zh: 那間老旅店的窗簾髒兮兮的，還有股霉味。

senses.en: careful and economical with money or food
simple and inexpensive

ex.en: By living a frugal life, they saved enough to buy a house.
ex.zh: 靠著節儉的生活，他們存夠了錢買房子。

root.note: 珍惜收成的 → 節儉的

senses.en: the realization or fulfillment of a plan or project

ex.en: After ten years of work, her dream finally came to fruition.
ex.zh: 經過十年的努力，她的夢想終於實現了。

mn: 常用片語 come to fruition（實現）。

senses.en: tending to disappear quickly; fleeting

ex.en: Fame on social media is often fugacious.
ex.zh: 社群媒體上的名氣往往轉瞬即逝。

root.note: 容易逃走的 → 短暫的

senses.en: the point on which a lever rests or turns
the central or essential part of something

ex.en: A seesaw balances on a fulcrum in the middle.
ex.zh: 蹺蹺板靠中間的支點保持平衡。

senses.en: to protest or criticize angrily

ex.en: Critics continue to fulminate against the new tax.
ex.zh: 批評者持續猛烈抨擊這項新稅。

root.note: 像閃電般打下來 → 猛烈抨擊

senses.en: excessively flattering or insincere
generous or abundant

ex.en: His fulsome praise of the boss made his coworkers roll their eyes.
ex.zh: 他對老闆肉麻的吹捧讓同事們直翻白眼。

root.note: 滿到溢出來 → 過分的

mn: fulsome 不是「充分的」好意，傳統上指令人反感的過度讚美。

senses.en: to disinfect an area with chemical smoke or gas

ex.en: We had to fumigate the apartment to get rid of the termites.
ex.zh: 我們必須把公寓燻蒸消毒來消滅白蟻。

senses.en: a person with official duties, often minor ones

ex.en: A low-level functionary stamped our papers and sent us away.
ex.zh: 一名基層公務員在我們的文件上蓋了章就打發我們走了。

root.note: 執行職務的人 → 官員

senses.en: forming a necessary base or core; of central importance
a basic rule or principle (usually plural)

ex.en: Freedom of speech is a fundamental right in a democracy.
ex.zh: 言論自由是民主社會的基本權利。

root.note: 底部基礎的 → 根本的

senses.en: (of goods) interchangeable with another item of the same kind

ex.en: Money is fungible, so one dollar is as good as any other.
ex.zh: 金錢是可互換的，一塊錢和另一塊錢價值相同。

root.note: 能代替履行的 → 可互換的

mn: NFT 就是 non-fungible token（非同質化代幣）。

senses.en: of, like, or caused by fungi

ex.en: A fungous growth spread across the damp wall.
ex.zh: 潮濕的牆上長滿了一片菌類。

senses.en: a living thing such as a mushroom, mold, or yeast

ex.en: A fungus attacked the tomato plants after weeks of rain.
ex.zh: 連下了幾週雨之後，番茄株遭到真菌感染。

senses.en: to polish or restore something to good condition

ex.en: The new owners plan to furbish the old theater before reopening it.
ex.zh: 新業主打算在重新開幕前整修這座老戲院。

mn: refurbish（翻修）比 furbish 更常用。

senses.en: a unit of distance equal to one-eighth of a mile (about 201 meters)
senses.zh: 浪（長度單位，約 201 公尺）

ex.en: The horse took the lead in the final furlong of the race.
ex.zh: 那匹馬在比賽最後一浪取得領先。

root.note: 一條犁溝的長度 → 浪

senses.en: a leave of absence, especially for soldiers
a temporary unpaid leave from work
to put workers on temporary unpaid leave

ex.en: The factory put hundreds of workers on furlough during the slowdown.
ex.zh: 景氣低迷期間，工廠讓數百名員工放無薪假。

senses.en: a person who prepares or sells furs

ex.en: The old furrier had sold coats in the same shop for forty years.
ex.zh: 那位老毛皮商在同一間店賣了四十年大衣。

senses.en: to a greater extent or distance
additional
to help something progress

ex.en: Contact the office if you need further information.
ex.zh: 如果需要更多資訊，請聯絡辦公室。

mn: further 多指抽象程度，farther 多指實際距離。

senses.en: the advancement of a plan or interest

ex.en: The grant was used in furtherance of cancer research.
ex.zh: 這筆補助被用來推動癌症研究。

senses.en: secretive, as if trying to avoid notice
senses.zh: 偷偷摸摸的；鬼鬼祟祟的

ex.en: He cast a furtive glance at his phone during the test.
ex.zh: 考試時，他偷偷瞄了一眼手機。

root.note: 像小偷一樣的 → 偷偷摸摸的

senses.en: to join or blend together
a safety device in an electric circuit
a cord that is lit to set off an explosive

ex.en: The chef likes to fuse Thai and Italian flavors.
ex.zh: 這位主廚喜歡融合泰式和義式風味。

root.note: 熔化後倒在一起 → 融合

senses.en: able to be melted or fused

ex.en: The sewing kit includes a fusible tape that bonds fabric with an iron.
ex.zh: 這套縫紉工具附有可熱熔的布襯，用熨斗就能黏合布料。

senses.en: incapable of producing any useful result; pointless

ex.en: It is futile to argue with him once he has made up his mind.
ex.zh: 他一旦下定決心，跟他爭論就是白費力氣。

root.note: 像漏水的容器一樣倒不滿 → 徒勞的
